design.primary: 100K QR lower quarter minus 100K DQN with the frozen 25 m/s governor, density 1, collision fraction.
design.primary_rule: Conditional scenario-bootstrap 95% interval must have upper endpoint below zero; report speed regardless. No tuning.
design.secondary: Budget effects pair the SAME new scenarios. Other policies/densities and three-seed crossed intervals are exploratory.
design.scope: Primary inference conditions on selected networks. Equal aggregate speed is not guaranteed. No new-training or real-road safety claim.
